title: Blue Mesa Fulfillment estoppel
summary: Estoppel dated November 16, 2026: the tenant confirms the lease's dates, rent and deposit, no options, no defaults and no claims.

evidence.quote: The undersigned, Blue Mesa Fulfillment (Tenant), certifies to Model Fund I — Runway Vista LLC and its lender as of November 16, 2026 as follows.
The undersigned, Blue Mesa Fulfillment (Tenant), certifies to Model Fund I — Runway Vista LLC and its lender as of November 16, 2026 as follows.
Tenant leases Unit 005 at Airport Flex Park containing 2,000 rentable square feet.
The Lease is dated March 1, 2022 and has not been amended; there are no amendments.
The Lease is dated March 1, 2022 and has not been amended; there are no amendments.
